title: metadata: a flow with an undeclared cycle (loop edge not typed back) reads valid as a draft and publishes, then the engine refuses to register it — a dead flow goes live
body:
domain:devx#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbX9avDwM2goWd7zimE

Filing gate: ① a product defect, found beside the clauses (studio-authoring.flow-edge-type-authoring), reach: the metadata draft and publish doors, measured twice.
Business reason: an author (API, MCP or a hand-written package) who publishes a loop flow without typing the loop-closing edge `back` gets a valid draft verdict and "published", and the flow never runs because the engine refuses to register it. The Studio canvas already flags the cycle; the server doors do not. #26707 closed the same "draft and publish say valid, the engine refuses" class for edge conditions.
Reader who acts: the triage seat, then the `domain:server` lane, `packages/metadata-protocol/src/runtime-authoring-gate.ts` (reuse the engine's cycle check). QA suggestion only: `area:automation`, p2.
Duplicate search: `flow cycle back edge publish registration refused` → 40 hits, the near ones closed and different (#28840 save_notice after a suspending child, #21982 / #21898 node config); `26707` → 11 hits, #26707 and #26858 closed for conditions and CEL fields, none for cycles.
Batch-of: release-18.3.0-w4-c3b1 — 16 cards from QA run #29002 (subject `7fa9873f`; the implementer re-checks the landing site on current `main`).

## Reproduction
1. `POST /api/v1/packages {"manifest":{"id":"com.qa.r6flow","name":"QA R6 Flow","version":"0.1.0","type":"app","namespace":"qsixf"}}`.
2. `PUT /api/v1/meta/flow/qsixf_cycle2?mode=draft&package=com.qa.r6flow` with nodes start → push (http) → check (decision) → revise (assignment) and edges start→push, push→check, push→end_err, check→end_a, check→end_b, check→revise (conditional), and revise→push with **no** `type`.
3. `GET …/qsixf_cycle2?state=draft&package=com.qa.r6flow` → `_diagnostics {"valid": true}`.
4. `POST /api/v1/packages/com.qa.r6flow/publish-drafts` → 200 `outcome: "published"`.
5. `GET /api/v1/meta/flow/qsixf_cycle2` → `registration {"state":"refused","reason":{"message":"Flow contains a cycle: push → check → revise → push. Only DAG flows are allowed — … mark the cycle-closing edge with type: 'back' (ADR-0044)."}}`; the boot log warns "a flow changed in the metadata store could not be registered".

Expected: the draft verdict and the publish gate refuse the undeclared cycle. Actual: valid draft, accepted publish, refused registration. Reproduced 2 times with fresh flows.

## Mechanism (suspected)
`runtime-authoring-gate.ts` has no cycle rule; the engine's `detectCycles` lives in `packages/services/service-automation/src/flow-registration-checks.ts`.

QA-source: #29002 · studio-authoring.flow-edge-type-authoring · observed beside the clauses
